text.tspan: Role: ship journald and auditd (audit.log) events
Role: DaemonSet ships pod logs over HEC;
local k3s demo is an optional test producer
Role: CloudTrail, GuardDuty, VPC Flow, S3 access logs
in S3; one SQS queue per type announces objects
Role: aggregator - receives native :6000 and HEC :8088,
VRL normalise, disk buffer, INSERT to ClickHouse
Role: poll SQS, read S3, VRL normalise, disk buffer
Off by default: aws profile; unit ships disabled
Role: audit trail of finished queries, filled by
Role: role siem_ingest, INSERT on siem.* only,
no reads; used by both Vector instances
all data stays on local disk
Role: dashboards, SQL explore, 7 AU-5 ingestion-silence
Role: log search and investigation over siem tables;
native local login; not on the ingest path
Role: HyperDX app state only (users, searches);
Role: sign in to Grafana :3000 or HyperDX :8081
with each app's local account; no SSO or MFA
Lines have no arrowheads: labels give protocol, port and DB account; OPTIONAL or (AWS) marks the AWS path
